raw_record.question_text: There are $20$ cities in the County of Newton. Their populations are shown in the bar chart below. The average population of all the cities is indicated by the horizontal dashed line. What is the closest total population of all $20$ cities?

method.method_draft: Read the dashed horizontal line in the chart as the average population. From the y-axis labels and gridlines, the dashed line is a little below halfway between 4000 and 6000, about 4700 to 4800 people per city. Read from the text that there are 20 cities. Use total = average × number of cities, so about 4750 × 20 = 95,000.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：柱状图的纵轴是 Population，标有 2000、4000、6000、8000 等水平网格线。表示平均人口的水平虚线位于 4000 和 6000 之间，并且略低于两者的中点，所以平均值约为 4700 到 4800 人，取约 4750 人/城市。推理：题目说明共有 20 个城市。总人口 = 平均人口 × 城市数 ≈ 4750 × 20 = 95000。因此最接近的总人口是 95,000。
